name: Freedom to Ruul
summary: In northern Ashenvale, Ruul waits in a cage deep inside Thistlefur Hold. He needs a Horde ally to help him fight through the corrupted furbolg den and reach safety.

sections.title: A Druid in Chains
sections.body: Ruul Snowhoof, a druid, is trapped in Thistlefur Hold. While exploring the corrupted woods of northern Ashenvale in bear form, he strayed too close to the den. The corrupted furbolgs had lost their ancestral wisdom and, driven by feral paranoia, mistook him for an ordinary beast. They caged and starved him instead of honoring him, draining his magic until he could no longer break free alone.

sections.title: Escape from the Den
sections.body: After hunger and imprisonment have weakened Ruul, he cannot change form or fight through the furbolg settlement alone. A Horde ally frees him and clears a path past hostile Thistlefurs. When they reach the outskirts of Splintertree Post, Ruul briefly takes his tauren form and gives heartfelt thanks. Then he returns to the wilderness to sleep off his exhaustion.

faq.q: Why was Ruul Snowhoof locked up by the furbolgs?
faq.answer: Ruul was exploring the forest in bear form when the corrupted Thistlefur furbolgs mistook him for a wild beast instead of a druid. They caged him and starved him until he was too weak to escape.
Yama Snowhoof is Ruul's sister, stationed at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She grew deeply worried when Ruul disappeared into the forest days earlier and did not return.

faq.q: Why couldn't Ruul just shift out of bear form to escape?
faq.answer: The Thistlefur furbolgs weakened Ruul through prolonged captivity and deliberate starvation. Without food or strength, his natural energy was spent, leaving him helpless until someone rescued him.

faq.q: What happens after Ruul reaches safety?
faq.answer: At the borders of Splintertree Post, Ruul briefly shifts into his natural tauren form to express his gratitude. Then he returns to bear form and finds a quiet place to sleep and recover.

faq.q: Are all furbolgs in Ashenvale hostile like the Thistlefurs?
faq.answer: No. Many furbolg tribes have a noble heritage and deep ties to nature, but the Thistlefurs of northern Ashenvale have fallen under corrupting influences that made them aggressive and unpredictable.

faq.q: Where does the rescue take place?
faq.answer: Ruul is held inside Thistlefur Hold, a furbolg den in the hills northwest of Splintertree Post and north of Astranaar in Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a druid, you know the risk of crossing feral lands in animal form, where corrupted locals may mistake you for prey.
As a tauren, you honor the bonds of the Earthmother and the Horde when you rescue a Cenarion brother and ease his kin's worry at Splintertree Post.
As a member of the Horde, you strengthen the precarious outpost at Splintertree Post with every soul rescued from northern Ashenvale's corrupted hollows.
